text:
sam: heads-up — we need a short RFC for how client-facing errors map to routing/quota decisions. current console shows raw 503s and users are confused. any opinions?

maya: agreed. my proposal: keep user-facing messages high-level, but add a compact machine-friendly hint header. human msg = friendly, hint header = actionable. :thumbsup:

derek: +1. want taxonomy: USER_ERROR (4xx), RATE_LIMIT (429), RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (custom 430?), TRANSIENT (503), INTERNAL (500). console should map these to dashboard categories for telemetry.

liz: question: do we expose routing reasons? e.g., "region fallback" vs "capacity tier". legal might object to exposing infra details. maybe hint code like "fallback:rg" not full text.

maya: exactly. use opaque short codes. e.g. X-RW-ERR-HINT: "quota:overage:acct_123" or "fallback:alt_model:v2". clients can parse but users only see friendly copy.

sam: can we standardize header names? ops wants consistent telemetry. proposal: X-RW-ERR-TYPE, X-RW-ERR-HINT, Retry-After (when relevant).

claire: also include a numeric hint id for rollouts so we can tie regressions to canary cohorts. like RW-HINT-ID=cr-0142. dashboard can filter on that.

derek: +1 on hint-id. but let's avoid leaking full rollout names. id opaque.

liz: UX: console error drilldown should show: friendly text, hint-id, sanitized hint string, and a link to runbook if available. telemetry counts both raw status and categorized taxonomy.

sam: quick example for API error body — agreeing on minimal surface: 1) http status 2) error.message (friendly) 3) error.code (stable string) 4) headers for hint. e.g.:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-ERR-TYPE: RATE_LIMIT
X-RW-ERR-HINT: quota:global:burst
X-RW-HINT-ID: qh-2026-004
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": {
    "message": "Request rate exceeded. See billing/quotas.",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded"
  }
}
```

maya: that looks good. one nuance: some SDKs swallow headers on CORS — we should document required headers and advise customers to surface them.

sam: telemetry note — we need event tags: taxonomy, hint-id, model-variant, region, tenant-tier. these feed alerts for rollouts and quota regressions.

derek: for rollouts fallback we should add a new taxonomy value: FALLBACK_DEGRADE (when response came from cheaper model due to capacity). console should show % of requests degraded per route.

liz: any objections to using 430 for resource_exhausted vs reusing 429? some HTTP purists hate new codes.

claire: prefer keep 429 and use error.code to differentiate (e.g., "quota_limit_burst" vs "quota_limit_monthly"). avoids new codes.

sam: ok consensus: stick with standard codes, enrich with error.code + headers + hint-id. docs + SDKs will surface header parsing helpers. follow-ups: maya to draft short RFC, derek to outline telemetry fields, liz to mock console drilldown. I'll open a repo issue and tag folks.

ops-bot: created issue RW-ENG-1347: "error-surface-and-hint-headers-rfc" assigned to maya, derek, liz. due 2026-04-02. :robot_face:
